data.title: Income Tax Assessment for 2025
data.summary: Finanzamt Beispiel-Vegesack assessed Bente Beispielhusen's income tax for 2025, including rental income from a property at Hafenkante 7, resulting in a remaining payment of €1,624.00 due on 28 December 2026.
data.explanation: This is your income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025. It combines your salary with rental income from Hafenkante 7 and various deductions, leaving an outstanding amount of €1,624.00 due on 28 December 2026, payable to the account shown using your tax number as reference. Missing this date triggers late-payment surcharges for each month started. If you think the assessment is wrong - for example about the depreciation applied to the rental property - you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or electronically with the Finanzamt; the app shows until when. No justification is required, though giving one can help. Consider professional tax advice if you are unsure.
data.tax_note: This is the income tax assessment itself for 2025, relevant to keep for records; it also documents the depreciation treatment of the rented property and its kitchen, which affects future years' rental income calculations.
